scope: Earliest scheduled hospitality week01 union, 9 distinct current primary rasters. Three successive visual groups; not a binding/count-only check.
method: Opened each current raster at full native1536x1024 with view_image; compared visible subjects/actions against current Japanese objectives and teaching bodies.

units.observed: Guest points to calendar; colleague consults reservation workspace. Twin-bed inset and breakfast tray support room/meal condition distinction, without numbers or a completed availability assertion.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: front01-s02/s03: latest availability; actual room configuration and meal inclusion must be confirmed.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.topic: Record reservation information and hand off arrival/meal needs
units.observed: Receptionist records a telephone request; colleague consults a clipboard with restaurant and entrance staff. Different uniforms clarify roles.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: front02-s01/s02: record dates/contact/guest needs; pass food allergy information to meal department and arrival details to relevant staff. Scene does not assert that a particular meal is allergy-safe.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.observed: Receptionist holds a room card and points to a practice site map. No generated map labels imply a verified route.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: front03-s03/s04: key handoff and facility/evacuation guidance. Exact routes remain in the source-bound native floorplan.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.observed: Left scene shows phone request and towel staff handoff; right scene shows knocking at a fully closed room door, without entering or assuming consent.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: front04-s03/s04: repeat request and knock/wait for permission; normal delivery not emergency-entry policy.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.observed: Staff and guest inspect line-item form; terminal and receipt printer are idle. No invented amount/tax/tip label is baked in.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: front05-s02/s03: plan inclusion, itemized review, payment confirmation then receipt.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.observed: Manager and employee inspect reservation record; colleague phones with alternative-hotel brochure available. No guaranteed alternative vacancy is implied.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: front06-s01/s02/s04: determine cause and coordinate responsibility, contact and actual alternative availability.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.observed: Receptionist directly consults wheelchair-using guest with room/bathroom brochure; background staff keeps record facing inward. No passport or room details exposed.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: front07-s03/s04/s05: ask individual support needs and confirm facilities; no certified wheelchair accessibility inferred from brochure.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.observed: Guest selects between room, breakfast, dinner and facility pictures while staff records choices; calendar is unnumbered.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: planning01-meal/consecutive/inclusive: images illustrate options; meal quantities/inclusion and nights remain written conditions.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review

units.observed: Staff compare separate room records and calculator; screen separates record area and room picture. No misleading generated revenue formula.
units.lessonKnowledgeComparison: planning02 scope/OCC/ADR/RevPAR: source-bound native example must carry exact denominators and values; raster is supporting scene only.
units.decision: retain; no concrete mismatch found in scoped visual review
